is_anopheles.evidence: The paper discusses Anopheles mosquitoes as malaria vectors throughout the text.

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper mentions kdr-west (L1014F) and kdr-east (L1014S) alleles in Nigeria and Kenya (page 7).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: The paper is a review article and does not report primary genotype counts or frequencies for specific mosquito populations.

african_field_population.evidence: The paper is a review article and does not contain primary data from field-caught mosquitoes.

supplement.evidence: Not applicable as it is a review article.

assessment.summary: This is a review article on malaria burden, epidemiology, and control strategies. It does not report primary empirical data on insecticide-resistance markers in African Anopheles populations.
exclusion_reasons: Does not report extractable genotype data
Does not report primary field-collected mosquito data
